description: Fresh EN commercial printing press admission domain.

units.title: Color register
units.text: Color register describes how accurately the different ink separations align on the sheet. Poor register produces visible color fringes or doubled edges around printed features.

units.title: Blanket cleaning
units.text: The press blanket is cleaned after the machine is stopped and the safe maintenance mode is engaged. Operators do not reach into the printing unit while cylinders are moving.

units.title: Ink adjustment
units.text: The press operator adjusts ink keys after comparing the control strip with the approved target. Large corrections are made gradually so one zone does not overshoot while neighboring zones remain stable.

units.title: Dryer fault
units.text: If the dryer reports an over-temperature fault, the press is stopped and the exhaust path is checked before production resumes. The fault is not cleared simply by increasing web speed.

units.title: Approved proof
units.text: An approved proof is the reference used to compare color, image placement, and major content before the production run is accepted. It does not replace mechanical safety checks.

units.title: Sheet jam
units.text: For a sheet jam, the feeder is stopped and stored energy is controlled before the operator removes trapped material. Production restarts only after the paper path is clear.
